what_changed:
Sidebar: library sections for People, Favorites, Archive, Albums, Tags, Folders and Trash (PR #19).
• Albums, tags and folders have overview pages and expand into lists in the sidebar
• The info panel's albums, tags and folder now open their pages
• People page can include people hidden in Immich
• Trash: restore, delete permanently, restore all, and empty trash
• View-only for now; lists load when a section is opened

Fixes: the window stays fullscreen when the app brings itself to the front; Explore stays on an open album or person while its overview reloads.

Custom HTTP headers: send proxy auth headers with Immich requests.
• Turn on Enable custom HTTP headers under Settings -> Immich Server, then add any number of rows
• Applied to API calls, Local URL probing, thumbnails, uploads/downloads, and video playback, but never to CDN/S3 redirects

Packaging: CMake options for distro builds (PR #14) — disable in-app updater, rename the executable, and show build info like "(AUR)".

Docs: Arch Linux AUR package mentioned in the README (PR #15).

Library performance on large libraries (PR #13): batch offline-cache writes, only show tiles near the viewport, fix new-photo checks for Live Photos / after streamed refresh, and retry thumbnails that 404 right after upload.

Viewer: step through photos and videos in Library and Explore (PR #7).
• On-screen controls or arrow keys; videos play in the shared viewer
• Explore gets Copy/Download/Share/Trash/Delete; deleted items leave Explore lists

Library & Explore: zoomable thumbnail grids and a collapsible sidebar (PR #8).
• Zoom with +/- or Ctrl+scroll; tile size is remembered
• Sidebar collapses on demand and auto-collapses on narrow windows
• Larger zoom loads sharper tile images

Viewer info panel (PR #9).
• Toggle with Info, I, or the thumbnail context menu
• Date, camera, location, people, albums, tags; click to jump into Library/Explore

mTLS client certificates (PR #11, closes #10).
• PKCS#12 or PEM cert+key and optional CA in Settings -> Immich Server
• Hidden until Enable client certificate is checked; page scrolls when the form is tall
• Applies to remote-origin traffic only (not Local URL / CDN hops)

Library loads months progressively (fixes #12).
• Up to 4 months in parallel; newest months appear immediately
• Scroll space for the rest is reserved from timeline bucket counts

Also:
• Quieter Library toolbar (icon-only Upload/Refresh/Years, compact zoom)
• Rolling beta builds on every push to main (GitHub beta release + Snap beta/edge)
• About credits gardar as a major contributor

Internationalization (issue #17).
• Follow system UI language or choose a language in Settings -> Appearance (applies immediately)
• Embedded Qt translation catalogs, English plural forms, and initial German/French translations with English fallback
• Locale-aware dates and a documented Qt Linguist workflow for contributors
• Fix Linux/Snap build dependencies: install qt6-tools-dev-tools so LinguistTools can find lprodump
• Auto-generated translation completion table in the README (and translations guide), refreshed by update_translations
• Apply language changes immediately by refreshing the interface while keeping uploads and folder watching running

Automatic translation updates.
• Download current language catalogs from GitHub at startup and language selection, without waiting for an app release
• Verify downloads and keep the last working copy, with embedded translations as an offline backup
• Publish updated catalogs automatically when translation sources change on main

CI fixes so package builds stay green.
• TlsConfigTest uses QTEST_GUILESS_MAIN (no display) while still linking Qt Gui for AppSettings/Theme headers
• QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen in workflows; translation .qm build ordering for MSBuild
• Windows Qt install: drop invalid qttools module request (Linguist is in the Qt 6.8 base package)
• Build immich_app as a STATIC library so MSVC can link AUTORCC resources (OBJECT libs broke qrc_resources.obj)
• Embed resources.qrc and the Windows .ico on the immich executable (static libs left MinGW builds with an empty PE icon table)
• Install Linux hicolor app icons for 16–512px so desktop environments resolve immich-desktop

Polish language support.
• Translate all 547 application messages, including Polish plural forms, dialogs, errors and settings
• Publish Polish for automatic GitHub downloads and include it as an embedded offline backup
• Keep upload retry status independent of translated error text
• Validate full Polish catalog coverage, formatting tokens, links and plural forms in automated tests

Combo boxes no longer change value when scrolling over them (wheel only works while the dropdown is open)

Simplified Chinese translation (PR #18).
• Complete zh_CN catalog (547/547), including Chinese plural forms
• Catalog and UI tests for coverage, placeholders, and language switching
